name: Cours Florent
description:
Want to study at one of France's most prestigious drama schools?

Established in 1967, Cours Florent is a theatrical innovation and artistic exploration place.

With a legacy of over five decades, Cours Florent continues to excel in performing arts education, providing students with the skills and opportunities to thrive in theatre and film.

From foundational courses in acting to specialised workshops in voice, movement, and character development, Cours Florent provides students with a well-rounded education to cultivate their artistic skills.

The institution offers a range of programs, including full-time acting courses, and part-time workshops, catering to students of all levels and backgrounds.

Additionally, the institution partners with leading industry professionals, casting directors, and production companies, providing students with opportunities for auditions, internships, and professional engagements.

Want to know more? Discover why Cours Florent might be the place for you!

The institution boasts modern facilities equipped with state-of-the-art studios, performance venues, and rehearsal spaces, providing students with an immersive environment for artistic exploration.

Additionally, the campus features a dedicated library, film screening rooms, and communal areas.

Why Cours Florent?

  • The institution offers a range of programs, catering to students of all levels and backgrounds. Cours Florent hosts over 2,000 students annually, representing a diverse array of nationalities and cultural backgrounds.
  • With a faculty of experienced industry professionals, Cours Florent provides hands-on training. The institution's extensive alumni network and industry connections provide a lot of opportunities for graduates in their professional journey. 
  • Cours Florent also collaborates with leading industry professionals within the entertainment industry.
  • The institution also showcases talents annually and attracts industry professionals and casting directors, providing students with exposure and networking opportunities.

Student Life

Cours Florent offers a dynamic and enriching student life. Students are immersed in a community of fellow performers and artists.

Students can participate in various extracurricular activities, including productions, masterclasses, and events. The institution also hosts regular performances and festivals that showcase students' talents and achievements.
